stories.title: Gronant woman among five convicted in Rhyl child sexual exploitation case
stories.summary: A woman from Gronant is among five people convicted following a North Wales Police investigation into the sexual exploitation of three teenage girls in Rhyl. stories.title: Appeal overturns refusal of 121 affordable homes at Oakenholt
stories.summary: Plans to build 121 affordable homes in Oakenholt – which were branded a ‘ghetto’ when they were turned down – have been granted after an appeal. stories.title: Hawarden: Permission granted to convert former Old Grocery restaurant into house
stories.summary: A councillor’s warning that Hawarden was losing a community building has not stopped permission being granted to turn the former Old Grocery restaurant at 68 The Highway into a family home. Councillor Sam Swash, who represents Hawarden: Mancot for Flintshire People’s Voice, objected on the grounds that the building had served the village for generations.

stories.title: Road closures at Caerwys and Llanfynydd among this week’s Flintshire roadworks
stories.summary: Nineteen new sets of roadworks start across Flintshire this week, including road closures at Caerwys and Llanfynydd and two sets of water works in Mold. stories.title: Flintshire households have until 23 August to secure £150 energy discount
stories.summary: Households in Flintshire on means-tested benefits have until Sunday 23 August to check they are named on their electricity bill, or risk missing a £150 discount this winter. The Warm Home Discount is applied automatically, but only for the person named on the account. Energy suppliers will use their customer records as those records stand
